warrants.quote: Each December Common Stock Warrant is exercisable for a period of five and one-half years from the issuance date at an exercise price of $5.00 per share, subject to adjustment
The December Wainwright Warrants are exercisable for a period of five and one-half years from the issuance date at an exercise price of $6.25 per share, subject to adjustment
Each December Pre-Funded Warrant is exercisable until exercised in full at an exercise price of $0.001 per share and may be exercised on a cashless basis.
